name: CiteMe
summary: Citation generator and reference checker formatting real source records in 60+ citation styles.
description: Free online citation generator and bibliography maker. Paste a DOI, ISBN, PMID, arXiv ID, URL, paper title or topic; CiteMe finds a source record in scholarly indexes (CrossRef, OpenAlex, PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, Google Books) and formats it in 60+ curated styles plus 10,000+ CSL styles. Also reference checking, PDF-to-BibTeX/RIS conversion, browser extensions, an API and an MCP server for AI assistants.
contains: 10+ scholarly sources: CrossRef, OpenAlex, PubMed, Europe PMC, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, Google Books
60+ curated citation styles plus 10,000+ CSL styles
citation generator, reference checker, DOI/ISBN/PMID/arXiv lookups, PDF to BibTeX/RIS
API and MCP server for agents; no key needed for basic use
Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari extensions
free plan; Pro from $2.99/week adds batch PDF import and Word export
source provenance shown and unverifiable results labelled for review
